name: mutex
title: A lock that sleeps
summary: Every worker takes one lock around a critical section: a spinlock, a lock whose waiters sleep on the lock word, or one that spins a little before sleeping. The page counts spins, sleeps and time.

controls.name: operation
controls.label: Lock
controls.hint: spin: the spinlock. sleep: waiters sleep on the lock word until a release wakes one. spin-then-sleep: a hundred tries, then sleep.

results.name: expected
results.label: Expected
results.what: workers times critical sections per worker

results.name: observed
results.label: Observed
results.what: the counter after the last worker finished

results.name: sleeps
results.label: Sleeps
results.what: times a worker went to sleep on the lock word, all workers

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model where a spinning worker takes steps that do nothing and a sleeping worker takes none until woken
